title: The party as publicity and who was there
summary: Stanley Dance calls it a publicity stunt; they list guests and agree the Basie men were the thrill.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band
